# VMEG

> VMEG is an AI-powered video localization platform offering voice cloning, dubbing, translation, and transcription across 170+ languages with lip-sync and subtitle support.

VMEG provides a comprehensive suite of free, no-signup-required tools for video and audio processing. The platform specializes in multilingual video translation with advanced voice cloning and lip-sync capabilities, making it ideal for content creators, filmmakers, and media professionals seeking to localize videos globally.

## Key Topics

- Voice Cloning
- Video Translation
- AI Dubbing
- Lip-Sync
- Subtitle Generation
- Text-to-Speech
- Multilingual Support (170+ languages)
- Video Localization
- Transcription (AI-powered)
- No Sign-up Required
- SRT Subtitles
- YouTube Integration
- Voice Synthesis
- Video-to-Text Conversion
- Subtitle Editor

## Video Translation & Dubbing

- [AI Video Translator: Free Video Language Translator Online](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/video-translator): Main video translator tool supporting 170+ languages with voice cloning
- [AI Video Dubbing Free Online: Video Dubber with Voice Cloning](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/ai-dubbing): AI dubbing tool with voice cloning, lip sync and auto-subtitles
- [AI Lip Sync Video Generator - VMEG AI](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/ai-lip-sync-video): AI lip-sync generator for multilingual video translation
- [YouTube Video Translator – Translate YouTube Videos & Audios to English](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/youtube-video-translator): YouTube-specific video translator with voice cloning and subtitles
- [Movie Translator & Language Converter: Translate Audio Voice](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/movie-translator): Movie translator with voice cloning for 170+ languages

## Voice & Speech Tools

- [Text to Speech - 7,000+ Realistic AI Voices with Voice Cloning](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/text-to-speech): Convert text to speech with 7,000+ voices in 170+ languages
- [Voice Cloning - Clone your Voice in Seconds](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/voice-cloning): Clone voices in 170+ languages with accuracy and emotion
- [AI Voice Generator - Real, Fast & High Quality](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/voiceover-generator): Generate professional voiceovers in 170+ languages

## Subtitle Tools

- [AI Subtitle Generator with Templates - VMEG AI](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/subtitle-generator): Auto-generate subtitles in 170+ languages with templates
- [AI Subtitle Translator Online - VMEG AI](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/subtitle-translator): Translate subtitles for long videos with instant results
- [Free MP4 to SRT Converter - Convert Video to SRT Online](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/mp4-to-srt): Convert MP4 videos to SRT subtitle files instantly
- [Add SRT to MP4 Online - Auto Subtitles & Free Templates](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/add-srt-to-mp4): Merge SRT subtitles with MP4 videos with templates
- [MKV & MKS to SRT Converter: Extract subtitle from MKV & MKS files](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/mkv-to-srt): Extract and convert MKV/MKS files to SRT subtitles
- [Convert SRT Subtitle to Speech or MP3 Online - VMEG AI](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/subtitle-to-speech): Convert SRT subtitles to speech or MP3 audio

- [Audio to Text Converter - Transcribe Audio Free & Online](https://www.vmeg.ai/tools/audio-to-text): Transcribe audio in 170+ languages instantly
